sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y git zip unzip openjdk-17-jdk python3-pip autoconf libtool pkg-config zlib1g-dev libncurses5-dev libncursesw5-dev libtinfo5 cmake libffi-dev libssl-dev automake

pip3 install --user --upgrade Cython==0.29.33 virtualenv
pip3 install --user --upgrade buildozer

$HOME/.local/bin/buildozer android debug

# copy sdk from Setup Android SDK to buildozer for use it
mkdir -p $HOME/.buildozer/android/platform/android-sdk/licenses
cp -r $ANDROID_HOME/licenses/* $HOME/.buildozer/android/platform/android-sdk/licenses/

- name: Setup Android SDK
    uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
